Reading through everyone’s thoughtful feedback has definitely pushed me to take even more seriously the difference between how policies feel for customers versus how clear or justified those policies might be from the shop’s perspective. While I stand by my earlier view that it’s not reasonable to blame the barber for following those structural boundaries, I see even more clearly now that rigid application and lack of nuanced, compassionate communication can cause legitimate harm.
